title: Mobile and tablet polish pass
description: A second full responsive pass over every public page, at phone and tablet widths. The owner's four open calls from the October check are done: the header Subscribe button and footer social icons are 44px, small standalone links (volunteer card titles, Giving coming soon) have 44px tap areas, all text has a 12px floor (guarded site-wide by typeFloor.test.ts; the nav caret glyph is the one exemption), and /events shows the compact 'Browse & subscribe on Luma' card instead of Luma's empty embed when the imported events hold nothing upcoming (calendarEmbedUrl). A page-by-page review at 390px and 768px found and fixed more: the homepage, community and uncurated chapter photo walls cap at 12 photos with a 'Show all' button at 900px and below (smallScreenCapLimit) while desktop keeps the full wall; centred section heads no longer drop flush-left below 900px and sub-heads (h3) got real styling; past-event cards fill the width on a phone, the no-poster stand-in becomes a 16:9 band, and posters load at 720px; empty volunteer-role placeholders are not drawn in one-column grids; the Donate stat cards lose their 260px floor on phones; site pages (Privacy, About) lose a stray rule and ~130px gap under the banner; and the footer stacks at 900px so it no longer cramps at 768. The automated sweep (51 pages x 10 widths) stays at 0 failures, with advisories down from 458 to 72, almost all inline links inside sentences. SCOPE VERDICT: all 7 project deliverables were already resolved before this cycle, so none were delivered or deferred here. Within the plan, not done by eye: 320px and 1024px were judged only by the automated sweep, and the real-device checklist (iOS Safari, Android, iPad rotation, pinch-zoom) still needs physical devices; both were disclosed and accepted at the save gate. Mid-capture the dev server's content store went empty for every collection (single server, not a race); restarting it and recapturing the seeded scenarios one at a time recovered every frame.
